name: Kiri Kiri Mai
source:
Main character is a college student who has a perfect lover, but only formally, for the looks. Three years pass this way, but one day protagonist gets really interested in a cheerful and calm girl. Who will he meet this Christmas with?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名大学生，他有一个完美的情人，但只是形式上的，只是为了外表。三年过去了，有一天，主角对一位开朗、冷静的女孩产生了兴趣。这个圣诞节他会和谁见面呢？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
